questions.q: Who will update content day to day?

a.t: Content is generated by users/the product

wp.name: WordPress is your answer
wp.why: Your needs are exactly what WordPress does best — professional presence, easy content editing and standard functionality at a sane budget. Don’t let anyone sell you custom development for this; spend the savings on content and marketing instead.

cu.name: Custom development fits better
cu.why: Your website is really a product — users sign in and do things WordPress would have to be bent out of shape to support. A custom build (MERN stack, plus React Native if the app matters) costs more upfront but is the cheaper path once you count the rescue work a forced WordPress build would need.

hy.name: Consider the hybrid path
hy.why: A WordPress marketing site for SEO, content and enquiries, plus a custom app/backend where the product logic lives — each tool doing what it’s best at. This is often the most capital-efficient route for product businesses that also need to rank on Google.
